Facts:
- Brightwater’s 2025 population was 44,675 residents (NR-05).
- Brightwater’s corrected area is 921.4 square kilometres (NR-16).
- Millbrook’s 2025 population was 37,203 residents (NR-11).
- Millbrook’s area is 758.6 square kilometres (NR-11).

Calculations:
- Brightwater population density = 44,675 ÷ 921.4 = 48.479 residents per square kilometre.
- Millbrook population density = 37,203 ÷ 758.6 = 49.038 residents per square kilometre.
- Difference = 49.038 − 48.479 = 0.559 residents per square kilometre.

ANSWER: Millbrook | 0.559
